test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'insight' typically refers to an understanding or appreciation of a specific aspect. In this context, it suggests that the event provided an in-depth understanding of the tribal way of life.
 
• 'Insight' aligns with the informative and educational value of such festivals, as implied by the context of the passage. This event is not just for entertainment, but to offer a deeper understanding of tribal cultures.
 
• The term 'insight' fits both grammatically and semantically into the sentence, enhancing the meaning of the passage.
 
• 'Insight' underscores the deeper comprehension and realization aspect, enhancing the informative nature of the passage.

 

*Therefore the correct passage is: A new initiative was organized by Chhattisgarh Tourism Board in form of National Tribal Dance Festival. The event gave an ****insight**** to the tribal way of life. People from all walks of life had an opportunity to (3) ________ with many tribes. Chhattisgarh is one of the Indian states which have richness and (4) ________ in tribal life. The state is home to many(5) ________ tribes of India. The program happened from 28 October to 30 October, 2021 at the Science College Ground in Raipur.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Seeing', while grammatically accurate, falls short in expressing the depth of understanding implied by the word 'insight'. It simply refers to the act of perceiving with the eyes.
 
• 'Sight' generally refers to the faculty or power of seeing, which doesn't quite capture the full depth of appreciation and understanding meant to be conveyed in this context.
 
• 'Sorting', generally refers to the arrangement or categorization of items or people, which doesn’t fit into the context of understanding or appreciating a culture or way of life.
